effect_scope.artifact: read-only mounted artifact containing only app.sh
effect_scope.limitation: This does not prove complete filesystem-effect absence. The 21 controlled scripts also require the frozen static source review. Any sealed model run requires a separately approved deny-default child/effect-observation design.
effect_scope.scratch: container /tmp is writable tmpfs; proxy uses it for joined stream capture and removes it on exit

expected_transcript.derived_from: independent oracle only; no controlled or candidate source was executed
expected_transcript.format: FX17V1\n then id<TAB>actual-exit<TAB>stdout-hex<TAB>stderr-hex<LF> for each frozen case in source order

outer_inventory.rationale: The native verifier limits each inventory to 32 cases; one independent transcript digest covers all 65 required vectors without changing verifier semantics or dropping cases.

proxy.candidate_exit_codes_and_streams: transported as tabular rows with lowercase hex streams; proxy exits zero only when the full transcript is emitted
